description: This PHP class 'Arabic' converts Roman numerals to Arabic numerals. It includes methods for parsing Roman strings, recursive calculation, and error handling, and serves as part of a calculator extension within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Arabic
classes.description: A class that converts Roman numerals into Arabic numerals, providing utility functions for parsing and recursive calculation.

methods.name: calculateArabic
methods.description: Recursively computes the Arabic value of a Roman numeral represented as an array of characters.

methods.name: mollifyScrutinizer
methods.description: Ensures the input value is an array; returns an empty array otherwise.

methods.name: strSplit
methods.description: Splits a Roman numeral string into an array of characters.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Converts a Roman numeral (string or array) into its Arabic numeral equivalent, handling negative values and errors.
